player_intent: Run, crouch movement, and prone movement animate at a calmer, less visually fatiguing cadence without slowing the player's movement.
acceptance_rule: The saved canonical locomotion profile applies a 0.80 visual playback scale to standing, crouched, and prone AnimationTree time-scale nodes while CharacterBody3D movement-speed values remain unchanged.

nodes.role: Consumes the profile playback rate for standing, crouched, and prone visual cycles without writing the CharacterBody3D transform.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement speed, velocity, collision, stance, and root-motion policy
fire, reload, grenade, transition, and damage timing
SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority
weapon contacts, IK, square-shoulder posture, and animation route selection
visual_check: Run forward and strafe, then crouch-walk and crawl in res://main.tscn. Confirm the foot and body cycles are visibly slower, the player still covers the same distance per second, and no foot sliding, animation restart, weapon-contact, fire, or reload regression is visible.

system_delta.reason: The existing profile already separates visual playback cadence from authoritative movement. Lower its bounded presentation scale instead of changing movement velocity, clip assets, or AnimationTree ownership.

current.system: Canonical locomotion profile with a 0.88 visual playback scale

candidate.system: Same canonical locomotion graph with a 0.80 presentation-only playback scale
